note: Real, dated site changes only — the changelog generator refuses invented entries. Newest first. Maintained by the daily run; every entry must correspond to a shipped commit.

entries.title: The dataset now lives in git too
entries.note: Every verdict and every Thesis Tracker reading is mirrored to a public GitHub repository, rebuilt nightly. It only changes when a grade changes — so its commit history is an independent, timestamped record of when we changed our mind.

entries.title: Listed on the official MCP Registry
entries.note: com.agiscorecard/agi-scorecard is now on registry.modelcontextprotocol.io — AI agents can discover and call the Thesis Tracker, verdicts, market ledger and site search natively, no auth.

entries.title: First on-site subscriber
entries.note: The inline form converted its first reader end-to-end (homepage footer, Aug 14). The address is stored first-party; it syncs to the newsletter the moment the beehiiv key is configured.

entries.title: A dated status line on the most-read page
entries.note: "When will AGI arrive?" now opens with the two numbers that actually move: 504 days until the nearest forecast is settled, and 45 days with the Thesis Tracker stuck at 62.5 — the disagreement is moving, the evidence is not.

entries.title: English stock coverage completed
entries.note: Every US-listed name SunWatch tracks now has an English page — 18 of 18 — plus a new /en/stocks index. The names that are still Chinese-only are listed and labelled as such rather than quietly left out.

entries.title: The exposure tool now points at the one paid product
entries.note: /ai-stock-exposure is the most-used tool on the site and had no path to SunWatch, the only subscription on this domain with a real price. It has one now — with the public hit-and-miss ledger linked, not a claim.

entries.title: New tool: Your AGI Timeline
entries.note: One slider places the year you expect AGI against nine real published forecasts — bull, base case or bear — with a shareable result. Free, embeddable.

entries.title: Holdings-update promise made accurate
entries.note: The invest pages no longer promise a same-day rewrite of every 13F. Holdings change only after a filing is read line by line — and subscribers hear the day the page changes.

entries.title: Opinion hook on the Altman page
entries.note: The second-most-cited page now asks where you land versus Altman's "few thousand days" — one tap onto the forecaster spectrum.

entries.title: More English stock pages
entries.note: Rocket Lab and SK hynix ADR added to the English invest pages (five now), with a fix so Chinese-named tickers render properly in English.

entries.title: Traffic reporting corrected
entries.note: Server-side "human" pageviews turned out to include an unrecognised crawler fleet; real-reader counts now come from JS-executed pageviews, and a UA audit records who is actually knocking.

entries.title: English stock pages on the invest console
entries.note: SunWatch's per-ticker analysis now has English pages (SanDisk, Micron, SpaceX to start), with reciprocal hreflang. More each run.

entries.title: MCP server live at /mcp
entries.note: AI agents can now call get_thesis_tracker, get_verdicts and search_site natively over Model Context Protocol — free, no auth.

entries.title: Calibration page published
entries.note: Every probability-shaped claim inventoried; Brier score pre-committed at n≥20. Misses stay published.

entries.title: AGI-2027 resolution page + odds-vs-evidence series
entries.note: Resolution criteria locked 17 months before the deadline; issue #1 comparing prediction-market odds with the evidence read.

entries.title: Site search with demand logging
entries.note: Full-site search (EN+中文) at /search; queries and zero-result gaps now drive what gets built next.

entries.title: Red-team desk on the invest console
entries.note: Survival odds (52–65%) for every open market call, strongest counter-case included; space-top confidence cut 60%→52% same day.

entries.title: Investing sub-sites merged under one domain
entries.note: SunWatch → invest.agiscorecard.com, AI Investing Compass → compass.agiscorecard.com; English landing + language negotiation added.

entries.title: One-tap flip poll on the Thesis Tracker
entries.note: Pick which open prediction flips first; per-prediction email alert stores your pick as the topic.

entries.title: On-site signup, no redirect
entries.note: All subscribe CTAs now open an inline form; addresses stored first-party before forwarding, per-context promises (e.g. 'one email, only if this verdict flips').

entries.title: First-party analytics + shareable baskets
entries.note: Server-side pageviews (counts AI crawlers ad blockers miss); /ai-stock-exposure baskets permalinked via ?b=NVDA-AMD-TSM.

entries.title: /ai-tools hub
entries.note: All free tools in one place; four embeddable via iframe.

entries.title: Site restructured: Research · Play · Invest
entries.note: Three-section navigation and directory; Chinese pages moved to a unified light design system.

entries.title: AGI-2027 Thesis Tracker launched
entries.note: One auditable 0–100 score recomputed from the 8 verdicts; history at /index-history.json. The AGI type test (/agi-test) shipped the same day.

entries.title: Scorecard launched
entries.note: 8 Situational Awareness predictions graded with pre-registered flip conditions; machine-readable at /data.json (CC BY 4.0).
